method: Full-field editorial translation with era-specific historical research; not an independent scholarly certification.

revisions.source: Today we will cover the need for religious tolerance. The Republicans are a party for all Americans.
revisions.zh: 今天，我们要谈宗教宽容的重要性。共和党属于全体美国人。

revisions.source: John D. Rockefeller has nothing to fear from a McKinley Administration. I reject the calls of certain mountebanks for the break-up or socialization of Standard Oil.
revisions.zh: 约翰·D.·洛克菲勒不必担心麦金莱政府。我反对那些江湖骗子鼓吹拆分标准石油公司，或把它改为社会所有。

revisions.source: Rockefeller knows my positions well. I feel as if it would be unbecoming to give him personal assurances, however. I work for all of the American people.
revisions.zh: 洛克菲勒很了解我的立场。不过，亲自向他作保证，我觉得有失身份。我为全体美国人民服务。

revisions.source: This antitrust legislation was passed with good reason. Business competition will inherently fail wherever monopolies exist.
revisions.zh: 反托拉斯立法的通过，自有充分的理由。垄断存在的地方，商业竞争就必然失灵。

revisions.source: Let's talk about the importance of reviving American business. Our tariff act will give them the protections they need to succeed.
revisions.zh: 谈谈振兴美国工商业的重要性吧。我们的关税法，将提供企业成功所需的保护。

revisions.source: Let's discuss world affairs. I support the annexation of Hawaii and I support the independence of Cuba. I support a stronger Navy.
revisions.zh: 谈谈国际事务吧。我支持吞并夏威夷，支持古巴独立，也支持建立更强大的海军。

revisions.source: Every man should have a right to bargain for his own wages. Let us reaffirm our opposition to collective bargaining and to radical labor unions.
revisions.zh: 每个人都应当有权自行商议工资。重申我们反对集体谈判，也反对激进工会。

revisions.source: Let's remind the voters that we will clean government up after four years of Democratic incompetence.
revisions.zh: 提醒选民：经历了民主党四年的无能执政，我们会整顿政府。

revisions.source: Let's address our speech to the workers and voters of the mid-Atlantic, who have been abandoned by the Democrats' nominee for this election.
revisions.zh: 让我们把这场演说讲给中大西洋地区的工人和选民听。他们已被本次大选的民主党候选人抛弃。

revisions.source: If we could be sure that the benefits would spread equally to the different states, I think a public works program could be helpful at this point.
revisions.zh: 如果能确保各州均等受益，我认为，眼下推行公共工程计划可能有所帮助。

revisions.source: I'm sure that Mr. Coxey is a well-intentioned citizen, but I see no constitutional authority for implementing a federal public works program.
revisions.zh: 我相信，考克西先生是一位善意的公民，但我看不出，宪法授予了实施联邦公共工程计划的权力。

revisions.source: This is absolutely the wrong solution to our business downturn. We must increase tariffs to stimulate American business.
revisions.zh: 这绝对不是解决商业萧条的正确办法。我们必须提高关税，促进美国工商业。

revisions.source: This is absolutely the wrong solution to our business downturn. We must allow the free coinage of silver to reduce the burden of our debts.
revisions.zh: 这绝对不是解决商业萧条的正确办法。我们必须允许白银自由铸币，减轻债务负担。

revisions.source: Internal areas of the country have the same rights to use our waterways as the coastal regions. Making the Mississippi more navigable and more flood-resistant could prove to be an economic windfall.
revisions.zh: 内陆地区与沿海地区，同样有权使用我国的水道。改善密西西比河的通航和防洪条件，可能带来巨大的经济收益。

revisions.source: This is another costly project that promises very little return on our investment.
revisions.zh: 这又是一个耗资巨大、却几乎看不到投资回报的工程。

revisions.source: This is not regulation of commerce under the Commerce Clause. This is direct action by the federal government to build and operate a public works project. I'm not sure that this is Constitutional.
revisions.zh: 这不是依据商业条款监管商业，而是联邦政府直接建设和经营公共工程。我不确定，这是否合宪。

revisions.source: Rockefeller gives you a solemn nod of approval. His support will be priceless this fall.
revisions.zh: 洛克菲勒郑重地点头表示赞许。今年秋天，他的支持将无比珍贵。

revisions.source: Rockefeller gives you a silent, unmistakable glare. He never thought he'd live to see a Republican of your ilk speaking out against his business.
revisions.zh: 洛克菲勒一言不发，却明显狠狠瞪了你一眼。他从未想过，有生之年竟会看到你这样的共和党人，公开反对他的企业。

revisions.source: Bryan's reputation amongst industrial workers is actually suspect (he is often perceived as being too pro-farmer and too evangelical). Do you have any plans to win this traditionally Democratic block of voters?
revisions.zh: 布赖恩在产业工人中的声望其实颇受质疑：人们往往觉得，他太偏向农民，宗教热情也太强。你有什么计划，争取这批传统上支持民主党的选民？

revisions.source: Should corporations be permitted to hire private detectives for security, and to infiltrate into labor movements?
revisions.zh: 应当允许企业雇用私人侦探负责安保，并渗透进劳工运动吗？

revisions.source: Do you think that the United States Navy is large enough to adequately defend American interests on a global level?
revisions.zh: 你认为，美国海军的规模，足以在全球范围内维护美国利益吗？

revisions.source: Will you press for your party to include a condemnation of lynching in the party platform?
revisions.zh: 你会推动本党在党纲中加入谴责私刑的条款吗？

revisions.source: Should there be some regulation of working hours for children, particularly those under the age of 12 or 13?
revisions.zh: 应当规范儿童的工作时间吗，尤其是十二三岁以下的儿童？

revisions.source: Business owners should threaten the workers with further unemployment if Bryan wins.
revisions.zh: 企业主应当威胁工人：如果布赖恩获胜，他们将面临更多失业。

revisions.source: We will remind laborers that inflation will debase the value of their wages. Silver coinage is a rural policy.
revisions.zh: 我们会提醒劳工，通货膨胀会降低工资的价值。白银铸币是面向农村的政策。

revisions.source: Let's remind the immigrant populations that Bryan is a religious fanatic who opposes the sale of alcohol.
revisions.zh: 提醒移民群体：布赖恩是个宗教狂热分子，反对出售酒类。

revisions.source: Americans are one people. We will not do special messaging for special interest groups.
revisions.zh: 美国人是一个整体。我们不会为了某些特殊利益群体，另说一套话。

revisions.source: It agonizes me that we do not have this protection in place. Have we not seen children who are seven years old losing their hands in the cotton looms?
revisions.zh: 我们竟然还没有这种保障，真让我痛心。难道我们没见过，七岁的孩子在棉纺织机里失去双手吗？

revisions.source: I believe this is warranted in the industrial trades. Let us not forget that all hands are needed on the farm, not least of all in this day and age.
revisions.zh: 我认为，这在工业行业中是必要的。可别忘了，农场需要所有人手，尤其是在眼下这个时代。

revisions.source: It falls outside the scope of the Constitution for the federal government to regulate the working conditions within a factory. This is not something that the President has control over.
revisions.zh: 联邦政府规范工厂内部的劳动条件，超出了宪法规定的权限。这不是总统能管的事。

revisions.source: The Navy is more than adequate to meet our current needs, and will remain so as long as imperialist Republicans avoid intervening in Cuba or Hawaii.
revisions.zh: 海军完全足以应付当前需要。只要那些帝国主义共和党人不插手古巴或夏威夷，今后也会如此。

revisions.source: I am disappointed with the backward status of our Navy. We need a more vigorous fleet, and we need a canal in Nicaragua to more closely link our two coasts.
revisions.zh: 我国海军的落后状况让我失望。我们需要一支更强劲的舰队，也需要尼加拉瓜运河，更紧密地连接东西两岸。

revisions.source: This is another sad attempt to crush the spirit of the working man. It's difficult to distinguish between Pinkertons and vigilantes during some of these repression actions.
revisions.zh: 这又是一次压垮工人精神的可悲尝试。在某些镇压行动中，平克顿侦探与私刑暴徒几乎没有区别。

revisions.source: Perhaps if collective bargaining was protected, companies would have less cause to fear their own employees.
revisions.zh: 如果集体谈判得到保障，企业也许就没那么多理由害怕自己的雇员了。

revisions.source: I don't see who has the authority to stop this. This is another example of regulation that would fall outside of the scope of the Commerce Clause in the Constitution.
revisions.zh: 我看不出，谁有权阻止这种做法。这又是一种超出宪法商业条款范围的监管。

revisions.source: The practice of hiring detectives from agencies like the Pinkertons is justified by the militancy and danger of the American labor movement.
revisions.zh: 美国劳工运动如此激进而危险，企业雇用平克顿等机构的侦探，是有理由的。

revisions.source: I abhor any instance where extra-judicial punishment is meted out by the passions of an inflamed mob. My party will speak out against this practice in our platform.
revisions.zh: 我憎恶一切因暴怒人群的激情而施行的法外惩罚。本党将在党纲中谴责这种做法。

revisions.source: This has no hope of becoming law, but we have to include the plank in order to appease the southern delegates who secured my nomination.
revisions.zh: 这不可能成为法律，但我们必须把这一条写进党纲，安抚那些确保我获得提名的南方代表。

revisions.source: This isn't an issue worth addressing. It will please no one and offend everyone, at least within our party's rank-and-file.
revisions.zh: 这不是值得讨论的问题。至少在本党普通党员中，提起它谁也讨好不了，反倒会得罪所有人。

revisions.source: These types incidents will happen when the federal government's due process Amendments fail to account for the innate differences among the citizens of the South.
revisions.zh: 联邦政府有关正当法律程序的宪法修正案，没有考虑到南方公民之间天生的差异，这类事件因此会发生。

revisions.source: There's nothing the Republicans can do about it, but at least you have the moral victory of a strong statement against injustice.
revisions.zh: 共和党对此无能为力，但至少，发表有力声明反对不公，让你在道义上赢了一局。

revisions.source: Once your views become well-known, Southern Democrats will defect in droves for John Palmer, the Bourbon Democrats' splinter candidate.
revisions.zh: 一旦你的观点广为人知，南方民主党人就会成群结队地转投约翰·帕尔默——波旁民主党分裂派的候选人。

revisions.source: Which of the following most closely matches your overall campaign message?
revisions.zh: 以下哪项最符合你的总体竞选诉求？

revisions.source:
You have alluded to the need for less prejudice between the races. Senator "Pitchfork" Ben Tillman, of South Carolina, privately seeks your clarification.
Can you reassure him that the federal government will respect the rights of the states under your Administration?
revisions.zh:
你曾暗示，应当减少种族间的偏见。南卡罗来纳州联邦参议员“干草叉”本·蒂尔曼私下找你，要求说明白。
你能否向他保证，执政时，联邦政府会尊重各州的权利？

revisions.source:
You have very little chance of winning New York this fall, and nearly all of that city's newspapers are anti-Bryan. That doesn't mean you couldn't draw a frenzied crowd in New York City.
Perhaps the media attention would be beneficial in building excitement for your campaign on a national scale?
revisions.zh:
今年秋天，你几乎不可能赢下纽约，该市报纸也几乎全都反对布赖恩。不过，这不代表你在纽约市就吸引不到热情高涨的人群。
也许媒体关注，能让你的竞选热潮蔓延到全国？

revisions.source: What do you have to say about William McKinley's campaign, at a high level?
revisions.zh: 总体上，你对威廉·麦金莱的竞选有什么评论？

revisions.source:
The novelty of a personal visit from the "Great Commoner" could probably swing the West Coast states in your direction. However, it will take two weeks to travel and return via train.
Will you divert your attention from the Midwest long enough to visit California, Oregon, and Washington?
revisions.zh:
“伟大的平民”亲自来访，这种新鲜感可能让西海岸各州转而支持你。不过，乘火车往返需要两周。
你会暂时把注意力从中西部移开，抽出这么长时间，访问加利福尼亚、俄勒冈和华盛顿吗？

revisions.source: What do you think of leaving the Midwest for a week and making a circuit of the crucial upper South states? (i.e. Delaware, Maryland, Virginia, West Virginia, and Kentucky)
revisions.zh: 你会离开中西部一周，巡访几个关键的南方北部州吗？（即特拉华、马里兰、弗吉尼亚、西弗吉尼亚和肯塔基。）

revisions.source: Can you respond to rumors that you would seek to abolish the Supreme Court if elected, due to their recent decisions on the income tax and antitrust issues?
revisions.zh: 有传言说，因为最高法院最近在所得税和反托拉斯问题上的裁决，你当选后将谋求废除最高法院。你能回应吗？

revisions.source: Critics have said that you wrap yourself in religious imagery too much for a presidential candidate. What is your response?
revisions.zh: 批评者说，作为总统候选人，你把自己包裹在宗教意象之中，做得太过了。你如何回应？

revisions.source: Do you support greater regulation on the sale and labeling of opium, cocaine, and morphine when used in patent medicines?
revisions.zh: 你支持对成药中使用的鸦片、可卡因和吗啡，加强销售与标签监管吗？

revisions.source: You are making a big speech in Chicago today. What points will you touch on?
revisions.zh: 今天，你将在芝加哥发表重要演说。你准备谈哪些要点？

revisions.source: The federal deficit has recently increased after two decades of steady decline. What are your thoughts on this?
revisions.zh: 联邦赤字在连续二十年稳步下降后，最近又增加了。你对此怎么看？

revisions.source: What is your opinion on the overthrow of the Hawaiian monarchy by the Dole group? Do you support the annexation of Hawaii into the United States?
revisions.zh: 你如何看待多尔集团推翻夏威夷君主制？你支持美国吞并夏威夷吗？

revisions.source: A few western states have allowed women the right to vote. Do you take the calls for a women's suffrage Amendment seriously?
revisions.zh: 西部已有几个州给予妇女投票权。对于要求通过妇女选举权宪法修正案的呼声，你会认真考虑吗？

revisions.source: There is one week left until election day. Every state is important, but where will you give an extra push with your personal campaigning to swing the final results?
revisions.zh: 离投票日还有一周。每个州都很重要，但你会亲自在哪里加大竞选力度，争取左右最终结果？

revisions.source: We support the free coinage of silver priced at a 16-to-1 ratio against gold. The results will aid farmers and workers of all classes and contribute to an American renewal.
revisions.zh: 我们支持按金银比价16∶1自由铸造银币。这将帮助各个阶层的农民和工人，推动美国复兴。

revisions.source: We will focus on free-silver and especially on the issues affecting farmers. We will seek a reduction in private debts and an end to the monopolistic practices of the railroads. We will also fight for the lowest possible tariffs.
revisions.zh: 我们将以自由铸银为重点，特别关注影响农民的问题。我们要减轻私人债务，结束铁路公司的垄断做法，也要争取尽可能低的关税。

revisions.source: Silver coinage is just one part of my platform. Let's not forget the struggles of the urban worker in his efforts to unionize and obtain fair wages.
revisions.zh: 白银铸币只是我纲领的一部分。别忘了，城市工人还在为组织工会、争取公平工资而奋斗。

revisions.source: I am 100% committed to the coinage of silver. It's important however, that we strike a moderate tone on other issues to expand our appeal as widely as we can.
revisions.zh: 我百分之百支持白银铸币。不过，为了尽可能扩大支持，在其他问题上，我们必须采取温和的语气。

revisions.source: McKinley is a fanatical defender of an obsolete monetary system. He is a front-man for big business and the New York financiers.
revisions.zh: 麦金莱狂热地维护一套过时的货币制度。他是大企业与纽约金融家的台前傀儡。

revisions.source: McKinley's support of high tariffs is a crime which strangles American commerce. Similar protectionist programs have twice been rejected by American voters in the past ten years alone.
revisions.zh: 麦金莱支持高关税，这是扼杀美国商业的罪行。仅在过去十年中，美国选民就已两次拒绝了类似的贸易保护政策。

revisions.source: We may have our disagreements, but William McKinley is an honorable man. Our campaign will focus on the issues, not on the opponent.
revisions.zh: 我们虽有分歧，但威廉·麦金莱是个正直的人。我们的竞选将着眼于议题，而不是针对对手本人。

revisions.source: McKinley's insistence on the gold standard has alienated many prominent Republicans from his own party, such as Henry Teller.
revisions.zh: 麦金莱坚持金本位，已经让亨利·特勒等许多重要的共和党人疏远了自己的党。

revisions.source: The Supreme Court has consistently stood in the way of progress by implementing an overly narrow interpretation of the Constitution. I support drastic measures to reduce its influence.
revisions.zh: 最高法院一贯把宪法解释得过于狭隘，阻挡进步。我支持采取激烈措施，削弱它的影响。

revisions.source: There have been some terrible decisions made by the Court. We might consider some measures to make the court more accountable to the popular will.
revisions.zh: 法院作出过一些糟糕的裁决。我们可以考虑一些办法，使法院更受民意约束。

revisions.source: This is an unfounded rumor that the McKinley campaign has disseminated to discredit my candidacy.
revisions.zh: 这是麦金莱阵营为损害我的候选人声誉，散布的无稽谣言。

revisions.source: 8 years of a William Jennings Bryan presidency will leave the Court in much better shape to address our nation's problems.
revisions.zh: 如果威廉·詹宁斯·布赖恩执政八年，最高法院将更有能力应对我国的问题。

revisions.source: Let us bring our message to the citizens of the Pacific Coast. Winning these three states could swing the entire election.
revisions.zh: 把我们的主张带到太平洋沿岸的民众那里去。拿下这三个州，可能改变整场选举的结果。

revisions.source: Let's keep the tour as short as possible. I will take a train to San Francisco and deliver a few speeches in that city, but will not tour the entire coast.
revisions.zh: 尽量缩短行程。我会乘火车到旧金山，在城里发表几次演说，但不会巡访整个海岸。

revisions.source: There is no time for that diversion. Heaven knows what rumors McKinley will spread while I am gone, and winning the Midwest should be our primary focus.
revisions.zh: 没有时间这样分心了。天知道，我不在的时候，麦金莱会散布什么谣言。拿下中西部，应当是我们的首要目标。

revisions.source: New York is a traditional Democratic stronghold, and I'm confident that the people of that state will support my message. We will campaign there extensively.
revisions.zh: 纽约是民主党的传统重镇，我相信，该州人民会支持我的主张。我们将在那里大力竞选。

revisions.source: Let's not waste our time in a hostile state. We must sow our seed upon the good earth where it will multiply.
revisions.zh: 别在敌意深重的州浪费时间。我们必须把种子撒在好土上，才会结出丰硕的果实。

revisions.source: I will give one big speech in New York City to open my campaign. Even if winning that state is hopeless, we need the national press.
revisions.zh: 我会在纽约市发表一场重要演说，为竞选揭幕。即便赢下该州毫无希望，我们也需要全国媒体的关注。

revisions.source: The humblest citizen in all the land, when clad in the armor of a righteous cause, is stronger than all the hosts of error.
revisions.zh: 哪怕是全国最卑微的公民，只要身披正义事业的铠甲，也比谬误的千军万马更强大。
